name: audition_smooth_rounded
description: An adult American woman speaking in a comfortable middle register. Smooth, rounded, velvety vocal tone with full, clear resonance. Broad flowing vowels, soft consonant edges, and gently connected phrases. Easy, unhurried conversational rhythm with a warm, reassuring presence. The voice sounds naturally feminine and mature. Clean dry studio speech.
reference_text: Hello, I'm here to help. We can work through your ideas together, one step at a time. Tell me what you're thinking, and I'll keep things clear, practical, and easy to follow.
